items.title: Pimicikamak Cree Nation residents rejoice as power returns after Manitoba Hydro fixes downed line
items.description: Power is being restored to Pimicikamak Cree Nation nearly four days after a widespread power outage left community members without heat in freezing winter temperatures and promoted a state of emergency.

items.title: Leading economists want less talk, more numbers from federal budget watchdog
items.description: This year, two things will happen to Canada's fiscal watchdog: Interim Parliamentary Budget Officer Jason Jacques will be replaced or made permanent, and the Organization for Economic Co-operation and Development will publish its review of the office.

items.title: Will Alberta's public-private health approach actually reduce wait times?
items.description: Health experts are divided on whether allowing surgeons to work in the public and private health systems simultaneously will shorten wait-lists.

items.title: Canadians ring in 2026 with ‘invigorating' polar plunges across the country
items.description: Hundreds across Canada marked the start of the new year by gleefully plunging into frigid lake and ocean water, some for their first time.
